message.content:
Based on my search, here are some of the notable art collaborations that took place in 2023:

## Fashion & Luxury Brand Collaborations

**Louis Vuitton x Yayoi Kusama** - One of the biggest art-fashion collaborations of 2023, this was the second chapter of their partnership (first established in 2012). The Japanese artist's iconic polka dots and pumpkin motifs were applied across Louis Vuitton's products including bags, shoes, perfume bottles, and storefronts worldwide, which were transformed into immersive Kusama installations. The collection was unveiled during the Louis Vuitton Cruise 2023 fashion show.

**Masquespacio x Monoprix** - The Spanish interior design studio collaborated with the French retail chain (established in 1932) to create a summer collection featuring approximately 50 pieces of ready-to-wear, tableware, and home accessories with anise green and pastel pink accents inspired by 1980s pop music and geometric prints.

**Guerlain x Jasmin Bonheur (Maison Matisse)** - Guerlain launched a jasmine fragrance with a flacon designed by Maison Matisse, based on Henri Matisse's famous work "A Thousand and One Nights."

**Jimmy Choo x Sailor Moon** - The luxury footwear brand collaborated with the Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon manga series for its 30th anniversary, creating five exclusive boots and bags representing the main characters.

**Longchamp x Fatboy** - These brands created a collection of large inflatable poufs based on Longchamp's "Le Pliage" canvas bag model, made from recycled polyester for "glamping" purposes.

## Gallery & Exhibition Collaborations

**Rosemary Mayer: Noon Has No Shadows** - A joint exhibition between Hannah Hoffman Gallery and Marc Selwyn Gallery in Los Angeles (November 12–December 23, 2023), organized with the Estate of Rosemary Mayer. This was astonishingly the late artist's first West Coast show, featuring large fabric sculptures and watercolor drawings.

**Art Collaboration Kyoto 2023 (ACK)** - ANOMALY (Tokyo), Fitzpatrick Gallery (Paris), and ROH (Jakarta) collaborated on a group presentation featuring works by Noe Aoki, Yusuke Asai, Takuro Tamayama, Louis Eisner, Hannah Weinberger, Cooper Jacoby, Syaiful Aulia Garibaldi, Maruto, and Dusadee Huntrakul.

**The Art of Collaboration: Summer Shows 2023** - At Arts University Bournemouth (AUB), students from BA (Hons) Photography and BA (Hons) Interior Architecture and Design collaborated on a poster exhibit curated by students Eliza Naden and Milly Harvey, showcasing cross-disciplinary work from various AUB departments.

## Museum & Institutional Collaborations

**National Portrait Gallery & Getty Museum Joint Acquisition** - On April 25, 2023, London's National Portrait Gallery and Los Angeles's J. Paul Getty Museum jointly purchased Sir Joshua Reynolds's famous "Portrait of Omai" for approximately £50 million, with plans to share the painting by sending it back and forth between institutions for six months at a time.

**Art Jakarta 2023** - Featured numerous collaborations including MINI partnering with Indonesian artist Syaiful Garibaldi on "The Mini Musa" art car concept using tillandsia usneoides, and TACO collaborating with South Korean artist Park Jihyun on the Special Edition of the "Thomson Series."

## Community & Social Art Collaborations

**Collaborative Art Space Projects** - Multiple collaborative initiatives ran throughout 2023:
- **Biennale: Space** (July–November 2023) - Collaborative Art Space's second International Collaborative Art Biennale, in collaboration with Tasmai, a Centre for Art and Culture
- **Jugalbandi** (August–November 2023) - Pairing artists with artisans, craftspeople, folk dancers, folk musicians, and folk singers
- **Community Art Project** (January–March 2023) - Community-based environmentally friendly art pieces made from at least 50% waste material
- **Not Yet Decided** (April–September 2023) - Youth collaboration project for artists aged 14–18

**Incognito Art Show 2023** - A national initiative based in Sydney where creatives of all ages anonymously contributed small A6 artworks to raise funds for artists living with disability through dedicated studio programs.

**Rivers of Steel Community Collaborations** - Included partnerships with the Society to Preserve the Millvale Murals of Maxo Vanka for the "Gledaj! The Gaze of Maxo Vanka" exhibition, as well as youth programs with Rankin Christian Center, Propel schools, and the Art in the Garden program offering metal arts, graffiti arts, and blacksmithing workshops.

## Art-Science Collaborations

**Nature's Chefs** - Members of the Dunn lab collaborated on a *Bioscience* publication about how organisms prepare food, with artist Eleanor Quist Olson creating a painting as a visual representation showing various plant and animal "chefs."

**Climate-Adapted Architectural Heritage** - A collaborative project bringing together scientists, artists, architects, and cultural scholars to reimagine traditional architecture in response to climate change, with an exhibition planned for 2026.

## Other Notable Collaborations

**Harmony Korine's EDGLRD** - The multi-hyphenate artist established a new creative lab bringing together artists from various disciplines to explore the intersection of music, films, art, and gaming.

**Tyler Mitchell for Ferragamo** - The photographer collaborated with Ferragamo for their Fall/Winter 2023 "New Renaissance" campaign.

**Shanghai International Art Fair 2023** - Collaborated with YRD International Cultural Industries Expo (YRDICIE) for the "Vision Driven" and "Art Leader Dream" initiatives, attracting over 120,000 visitors.
